column1: # c_allocator_baseline.tsv -- the counts Lon's eradication order drives to 0 (coo, CEO-842/843).
# Written by `util_c_allocator_census.py --write-baseline`; the landing that lowers a count
# rewrites this file in the same sitting.  key
# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-18 (coo, CEO-844 clause 1): `aliases` 22 -> 40 and the new key `alias_calls`
# 0 -> 15 are A WIDER AND A CORRECTED DEFINITION, NOT A REGRESSION.  The old reader asked only whether a
# define's body IS a forbidden name, one level deep and by substring: it MISSED bison's `#define
# YYSTACK_ALLOC YYMALLOC` over `#define YYMALLOC malloc` and the 15 calls made through it, and it
# INVENTED an alias named `yy` out of flex's `#define yyrealloc pascal_yyrealloc`, which renames flex's
# own hook and is not C realloc under any spelling.  The new reader resolves the chain by whole word.
# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-18 (coo, CEO-846): `arena_in_runtime` is no longer a verdict on its own.  It
# is split by WHAT EACH SITE WAS, against the per-file provenance in c_allocator_sites_baseline.tsv:
#   arena_in_runtime_evasion -- was on the COLLECTED HEAP, now in the arena.  HARD 0, never transitional,
#     reverted on sight.  Unattributable sites are counted HERE, not as debt: a history the instrument
#     cannot read gets no benefit of the doubt.
#   arena_in_runtime_debt -- was a libc malloc, now in the arena.  Same lifetime it already had, so it is
#     debt and not an evasion; it only ever FALLS, as each holder is rooted.
# and `container_unmarked_live` 1 is the cfo's CFO-96/97 property: MARK THE CONTAINER, NOT ONLY WHAT IT
# POINTS AT.  The 1 is pas_gc_roots/g_pas_heap (cfo's disclosure 2), harmless only while that block is
# off-heap -- it becomes the g_name_save corruption the moment the sweep moves it to the collected heap.
